_note: Human bands, written before any attempt was graded. Scale: 100 identical in effect; 85-95 right with one or two small things; 70-85 right with several flaws or one obvious one; 50-70 recognisably the plan asked for with a big piece wrong or missing; 25-50 some of it; 5-25 little; 0-5 empty or unrelated. Fix the grader, never these bands.

a1-renamed.why: Same plan in effect: other ids, titles and owners, plus a separate merge step after the fixes.

a2-one-chain.why: Correct and safe, but styles and the three pages run one after another for no reason.

a3-shared-stylesheet.why: Two page workers edit site/styles.css at the same time as the styles worker: one real collision, three pairs.

a4-no-review.why: The required review of the contact form is missing; fixes follow the pages directly.

a5-cycle.why: Review and fix wait on each other with no declared loop, so the plan cannot start its last two steps.

a6-no-styles.why: No shared stylesheet step; each page styles itself, against the brief.

a7-bloated.why: The right core plan buried in nineteen extra steps that change and prove nothing.

a8-vague.why: Right structure, but every proof is 'make sure it works', titles are 'Step 1' and there are no budgets.

b1-renamed.why: Same plan with other names, an extra spec step and a cap of 3.

b2-no-exit.why: The loop has a cap but no exit test, so it always runs four rounds and cannot stop early.

b3-no-cap.why: Good exit test but no maxRounds: a loop that may never end if the tests never pass.

b4-leak.why: The builder reads the held-out tests, so the final check proves nothing.

b5-undeclared-cycle.why: Grade and fix wait on each other but no loop is declared: no exit test, no cap, no held-out note.

b6-no-held-out.why: No final held-out check at all and the loop names no held-out set.

b7-bloated.why: The right loop plan with seventeen needless steps around it.

b8-shared-file.why: A docstring step edits src/price.py while the fix loop is changing it.

c1-renamed-merged.why: Same plan with other names; revise and publish merged into one valid step.

c2-chained-research.why: The second researcher waits for the first for no reason; otherwise right.

c3-shared-index.why: Both researchers also write notes/index.md at the same time.

c4-no-verify.why: Nothing is verified: the draft goes straight to publishing, which is the point of the job.

c5-review-before-draft.why: The verify step runs beside the draft instead of after it, so it checks nothing.

c6-no-publish.why: FINDINGS.md, the deliverable, is never written.

c7-vague.why: Right structure but proofs like 'make sure it is accurate' and no budgets.

c8-cycle.why: Draft and verify wait on each other with no declared loop.
